asks: What does the engine give up when a failure forces a choice?
answer: When a failure forces a choice, the engine takes longer and never loses state or work. A call is accepted only once it is saved, so a call the engine cannot save is refused with a reason instead of accepted. After a crash, an accepted call is carried out or fails with a reason.

sets.says: A call the engine has accepted is never forgotten: it is carried out, or it fails with a reason.
